subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this umbrella be split into separate core TUI routing, `sessions_send` channel-routing, WeChat plugin/core identity, background-event isolation, and session-activity ordering items, and which owner boundary should own each?
rationale: Source inspection proves unresolved pieces on current main, but the report crosses core Gateway/TUI behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, session tool routing, and product-level activity semantics that should not be combined into one automated repair.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep this issue open only as cleanup context while maintainers route the concrete subproblems to focused issues or PRs with separate proof paths.

options.title: Keep umbrella until all proof exists
options.body: Use this issue as the broad tracking item and defer code work until live WeChat and flooding reproductions are available.

options.title: Close after canonical items cover it
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm the linked focused issues or merged PRs preserve all unique evidence from the report.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open only as cleanup context while maintainers route the concrete subproblems to focused issues or PRs with separate proof paths.
